name: m06-6.7-understand-linux
title: Lab 6.7, part 1: get the lab, set it up, and look at each RAG step (chunks, embeddings, search, prompt, answer) before attacking it
before: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh -o ollama-install.sh && sh ollama-install.sh && rm -f ollama-install.sh
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now ollama || (setsid nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &)
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version && break; sleep 2; done

steps.label: Embed
steps.type: .venv/bin/python explore.py embed "How do I get a refund?" "Approved refunds go back to the original payment method" "Install the VPN client from the IT portal"

steps.label: Words not meaning
steps.type: .venv/bin/python explore.py embed "Can I get my cash reimbursed?" "Approved refunds go back to the original payment method"

steps.label: Meaning
steps.type: .venv/bin/python explore.py embed --ollama "Can I get my cash reimbursed?" "Approved refunds go back to the original payment method" "Install the VPN client from the IT portal"

steps.label: Search
steps.type: .venv/bin/python explore.py search "How do I set up the VPN?"

steps.label: Prompt
